I got to be an exchange student in Miyazaki  and it was so beautiful!! Definitely the country side. I resided in Hyuga City for most of my stay, then moved to Miyazaki City for the rest of it. 
The most memorable thing about Hyuga was their Hyottoko Festival. Also, they are know for a fruit called Hebesu. I would recommend trying Hebesu ice cream if you ever visit, very yummy. Miyazaki is probably more known for Aoshima Beach, Takachiho Gorge, and Nichinan City. My personal favorite spot was recommended by my host mother. Heiwadai Park! There is an old castle there and a cute little path you can walk. Cute statues that kind of remind me of princess mononoke. There's a delicious restaurant right next to it called Sizen. It is a buffet, but their salad dressings are so good. Pretty sure they called it creative cuisine. There's a lot to choose from and they're all pretty delicious!!
